channel.title: Trifacta incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Trifacta's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Connections to Alteryx Data Plane are Degraded - US1 [resolved]
Investigating Delays With File Conversions in Designer Cloud [resolved]
US1: Platform Performance Degradation - Slow Login and Application Load Times [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting login and application performance has been resolved.

item.title: US1 : Alteryx Analytics Cloud Platform is experiencing degraded performance [resolved]
Issues authenticating in US1 [resolved]
item.description: We've identified the problem and have determined impact to only a small subset of users. In the event issues continue, please open a support case with Alteryx support. Thank you.

item.title: New Assets Not Displaying in Library [resolved]
AU1 - Plan jobs are failing [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting AU1 plan jobs has been resolved. This was related to a Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) incident in australia-southeast1, where network traffic throttling between internal services caused disruptions to cluster operations; the issue has since been mitigated by Google.

item.title: AU1 is currently experiencing an outage [resolved]
Login Issues in US1/EU1/AU1 [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting Alteryx One SSO, caused by upstream Microsoft 365 service disruptions, has been fully resolved. Following a monitoring period, all services are operating normally, and OTP delivery is functioning as expected. This incident is now resolved.

item.title: Login Issues Due to Third-Party Vendor Outage [resolved]
Unable to login in all 3 regions (US1, AU1, EU1) [resolved]
Intermittent Issues in US1 - Elevated Error Rates [resolved]
